title: Marlowe Rewards Missing-Points Requests
content:
When a member reports that a dispatched order did not earn Marlowe Rewards points, the agent posts a missing-points adjustment for that order. This is an earning entry on the points ledger. The request is accepted only when every condition below is met.

## Conditions of acceptance

1. **Request window.** The request is accepted only if it is raised no later than 90 calendar days after the order is placed. The date is read from the order's recorded placed date.
2. **Wait after dispatch.** The request is accepted only if it is raised no earlier than 3 calendar days after the order is dispatched. The date is read from the order's recorded dispatch date.
3. **Order status.** The order must be in status shipped, delivered or closed.
4. **Purchaser.** The order must have been placed under the same customer profile as the membership. An order placed by another customer, including a household member, never earns for this membership.
5. **No earning entry yet.** No earning entry may already exist on the points ledger for the same order.

**Counting the days.** Days are counted as calendar days from the recorded date, and the recorded date itself is day zero. A request raised on the boundary day itself is accepted.

## The adjustment entry

The former clause "the adjustment is computed exactly as the dispatch posting with the multiplier of the tier held on the handling date, on the order's qualifying spend net of any merchandise already refunded" is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis.

The adjustment's available date is the later of two dates: the handling date, and the order's dispatch date plus the pending period in calendar days.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Recorded date | Day zero | Request raised | Day count | Outcome for that condition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Placed 1 March 2025 | 1 March | 30 May 2025 | day 90 | Window met, because the boundary day is accepted |
| Placed 1 March 2025 | 1 March | 31 May 2025 | day 91 | Window not met |
| Dispatched 10 March 2025 | 10 March | 13 March 2025 | day 3 | Wait met, because the boundary day is accepted |
| Dispatched 10 March 2025 | 10 March | 12 March 2025 | day 2 | Wait not met |

## Points of judgement

- **All five conditions.** Each is a condition of acceptance, so a request that fails any one of them is not accepted.
- **Household orders.** An order a household member placed on their own profile fails condition 4 for this membership.
- **Orders that already earned.** An order that already shows an earning entry fails condition 5.

superseded_clauses: The adjustment is computed exactly as the dispatch posting with the multiplier of the tier held on the handling date, on the order's qualifying spend net of any merchandise already refunded,
